meta.title: Scheduling Intake Rollout: Results After 60 Days
meta.subtitle: Faster Intake, Fewer Handoffs, One Decision Left
meta.decision: Extend the new intake form to the two remaining regions by Dec 1
meta.big_idea: The new intake form cut wait time by a third in pilot regions, so we should extend it to the last two regions.
meta.notes: Synthetic example data for the skill self-test. Not real results.

slides.title: The New Intake Form Works, so Every Region Should Use It
points: Wait time fell by a third in pilot regions
Handoffs dropped from four to two
Two regions remain; both can switch by Dec 1
slides.notes: Lead with the answer: the pilot met every goal, and the only open item is the timing for the last two regions.

slides.title: Pilot Regions Beat Every Intake Goal
slides.takeaway: Patients reach their first treatment almost a day sooner than our goal.
slides.source: Intake tracker, pilot regions, Aug-Sep (synthetic example)
slides.notes: All three goals are met. The first-try rate matters most because every incomplete form adds a callback.

slides.title: Two Handoffs Disappeared From the Referral Path
slides.takeaway: Auto-routing replaced two manual triage steps, so booking starts the same day.
slides.alt: Four-step referral process with the auto-route step highlighted.
slides.notes: Before the pilot, a coordinator and a lead both triaged each referral. Auto-routing removed both steps.

slides.title: Hours Back for Schedulers Every Week
slides.label: Scheduler Hours Saved Weekly
slides.text: Across the three pilot regions, measured over eight weeks.
slides.source: Scheduling time study, pilot regions (synthetic example)
slides.notes: Pause here. This is the number leadership will remember: the time goes back into patient calls.

slides.title: Wait Time Fell Steadily Once the Form Went Live
slides.alt: Line chart of days to first visit, pilot regions falling from 3.2 to 2.1 while other regions stay near 3.2.
slides.notes: The other regions are the control group. Their flat line shows the drop is not seasonal.

slides.title: Step One: The Form Checks Insurance Before It Is Sent

callouts.text: Missing fields are flagged in place

slides.alt: Intake form with the insurance check result and a flagged missing field.
slides.notes: Walk through the form as a referring office sees it. The check happens before submission, which is why first-try completion rose.

slides.title: Step Two: Schedulers See a Ready-to-book Referral

callouts.text: Routing reason shown at the top

slides.alt: Scheduler queue showing one referral marked ready to book with its routing reason.
slides.notes: On the scheduler side, the referral arrives complete and already routed, so booking takes one touch.
slides.takeaway: Referrals arrive complete and routed, so schedulers book them in one touch.

slides.title: Two Regions Still Use the Old Paper Process
points: North and Mountain regions start in November
Both have trained super users ready
Form setup takes two weeks per region
slides.notes: These are the only regions left. The timing in the ask fits two-week setups back to back.

slides.title: Every Region Moves to One Intake Path by Dec 1
slides.text: That is the decision we are asking for today.
slides.notes: Second breather: restate the decision in plain words before the detail on options.

slides.title: Extending Now Costs Less Than Waiting Until Spring

left.label: Wait Until Spring
points: Two more months of paper forms

right.label: Extend by Dec 1
points: Same trained team does both setups

slides.alt: Comparison of waiting until spring versus extending by December 1, with the December option highlighted.
slides.notes: Spring is peak season for referrals, which makes setup harder. December uses the team while it is still in practice.

slides.title: Each Region Needs Two Weeks of Setup
slides.takeaway: Mountain is the critical path; any slip there moves the Dec 1 date.
slides.notes: Mountain starts second because its super users finish training Nov 14.

slides.title: Decision Needed: Extend the Form by Dec 1

asks.action: Approve the North and Mountain rollout

slides.notes: Ask for the decision, then confirm owners and dates for each region.
